en.title: Rome Through Time
en.subtitle: One city. 2,000 years of change.
en.introNote: A living miniature of history. Drag through the centuries.
en.travelHint: Move the slider to watch Rome transform
en.hint: Drag to rotate · Scroll to zoom · Right-drag to pan
en.hintTouch: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom
en.motto: PICK A CITY. LET AI TELL ITS STORY.
en.notes1: This is a stylized, research-informed reconstruction of the Colosseum, Forum and Palatine area, not an archaeological survey. Landmark positions are fixed; neighborhood forms, terrain and building counts are illustrative.
en.notes2: The 125 AD scene omits later monuments such as the Arch of Constantine and Basilica of Maxentius. Later church forms are simplified interpretations of the surrounding historic center. Timeline intervals have equal visual length, not equal calendar duration.
en.notes3: Sources: Parco archeologico del Colosseo, “The Roman Forum” and “Life in the Colosseum in the Middle Ages” (colosseo.it).
en.notes4: No AI calls are made while exploring. Historical intervals are approximate artistic schedules.
en.chapter0Line: A city of spectacle, marble and imperial ambition.
en.chapter1Line: Ancient stone becomes shelter, pasture and a city reborn.
en.chapter2Line: Palaces and domes weave a new city around enduring ruins.
en.chapter3Line: Protected archaeology lives beside the rhythms of modern Rome.
en.webglMissing: This scene needs WebGL. Turn on hardware acceleration or try another browser.

zh-CN.title: 罗马穿越时光
zh-CN.subtitle: 一座城市，两千年的变迁。
zh-CN.introNote: 一座持续演变的历史微缩城市。拖动时间轴，穿越世纪。
zh-CN.travelHint: 拖动时间轴，观察城市演变
zh-CN.timelineAria: 公元 125 年至 2026 年的历史时间轴
zh-CN.hint: 拖动旋转 · 滚轮缩放 · 右键平移
zh-CN.hintTouch: 拖动旋转 · 双指缩放
zh-CN.motto: 选择一座城市，让 AI 讲述它的故事。
zh-CN.notes1: 本作品是斗兽场、古罗马广场与帕拉蒂尼山的艺术化微缩重建，不是考古测绘。地标锚点固定，街区、建筑数量与损毁时间窗口属于示意。
zh-CN.notes2: 公元 125 年场景不展示后建的君士坦丁凯旋门与马克森提乌斯会堂。后期教堂为周边历史街区的概括形态；四个时代节点在时间轴上等长，并不对应相等的年数。
zh-CN.notes3: 资料来源：罗马斗兽场考古公园（colosseo.it）的《古罗马广场》与《中世纪斗兽场里的生活》。
zh-CN.notes4: 浏览时不调用任何 AI。历史时间窗口为近似的艺术化安排。
zh-CN.chapter0Line: 一座属于观演、大理石与帝国雄心的城市。
zh-CN.chapter1Line: 古代石材成为住所与牧地，城市重新生长。
zh-CN.chapter2Line: 宫邸与穹顶在不朽的遗迹周围织出新的城市。
zh-CN.chapter3Line: 受保护的考古遗址与现代罗马的日常节奏并存。
zh-CN.webglMissing: 这个场景需要 WebGL。请开启硬件加速，或换一个浏览器。
